correctness.rationale: All 378 bitangent pairs in Q[e] yield exactly 252 double and 21 quadruple crossings. An independent 210-pair enumeration of 21 Klein lines gives 28 triples and 21 quadruples. An explicit pair of index permutations checks all 84 edges of the graph isomorphism. The 49x49 Laplacian characteristic polynomial gives the tree count 2^18*3^23*7^5; two exact integer Smith reductions and an independently implemented prime-local elimination at p=2,3,7 establish 36 units and 2^4,18,54,108,756^5, with no other prime factors. The packaged program was run from its exact files and produced the expected PASS output. The claim is restricted to this finite graph, not an infinite or approximate computation.

value.rationale: A complete natural integral group invariant of a highly symmetric 49-vertex algebraic-geometric incidence configuration is mathematically motivated by divisor theory on graphs and the tropical Jacobian of that dual graph. It is strictly finer information than classical incidence counts and real/complex spectrum and differs from the known integral group of the 42-vertex Klein graph formed using quadruple points. An exact complete invariant and explicit dual verification are valuable even without a downstream theorem.
